key_insight: CurvDelta confines model updates to a low-curvature space to learn or forget targeted capabilities while limiting degradation of general capabilities.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a preservation-aware approach to LLM adaptation, with CurvLoRA providing a low-rank option designed for greater efficiency.
method: Analyze local preservation-loss geometry around the pre-adaptation model.
Use K-FAC and factorized projection to construct low-curvature updates at LLM scale.
Apply CurvDelta or its low-rank variant, CurvLoRA, to capability learning and selective unlearning.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and TOFU/MUSE unlearning report improved acquisition–retention or forgetting–retention trade-offs, with unlearning retention close to from-scratch retraining.
watch_item: Preservation relies on local, approximate curvature; the abstract does not establish how well it holds for large updates or distribution shifts.
paper_title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
